077 · What else to bring from the testbed: foliage first, then the rest

Brief 077 step 5, 2026-10-30. The survey covers everything except the café trough planting (Vela is porting that now). The comparison is against today's swap (OldTown.unity: old builders outside, our Handover zone cut in), using the 1029 play-zoom shots. Read-only: no Unity, Blender, scene, kit or plan change. Perf labels: M = from a report, kit.json or a scene file; C = computed here from the testbed's own source (a node probe, out/scratch/survey077/probe/stats.mjs, which imports the testbed modules and reads their statistics()); E = estimate. Nothing here was measured on the Air.

Frame headroom first. Redline projects our district at 12.4 ms (11.0–13.9) against 13.0 (briefs/075/redline.md). The swap scene is heavier still: its zone views are an estimated 14.0–17.5 ms, from the old pipeline (MSAA 4, depth and opaque copies, DOF, flare). Its own-street views are an estimated 20–30 ms, mostly from the baked glTF crowd (61.3 M tris; briefs/075/oldbuild/perf.md). Every item below is either near-free (light, emissive, a shader on a small area) or should be paid for by item 7, and none of them should go in ahead of Redline's pipeline cuts and an Air sitting. Triangles are only a proxy here. On the M4 the risks are draws, light loops and alpha test, and every testbed plant is opaque geometry with no alpha.

Today against the references

Top recommendations, ranked

1Fountain garden planting in the four islands

fountain-garden.js, fountain-garden-layout.js (testbed), sharing the trough atlas

The fountain is the middle of the café square in both play yaws. Today the four PlanterArc islands hold rows of clipped green domes. The testbed islands carry rounded glossy leaf clumps, arching rosettes and three coral and amber flower clusters each, which is what the 26 Sep paintings show. The footprint is the same: civic-block.json already names fountain-garden-north-east…south-east and builds them as PlanterArc.

Owner: Vela (piece in tools/decokit, after the troughs settle the atlas and materials) · Latch (rebuild) · Redline (numbers)

Cost: Computed from the testbed source: all four islands with their stone come to 14,272 tris at the gameplay level, 24,048 near and 49,584 close. Today's four PlanterArc are 4 × 3,016 = 12,064, so the gameplay level adds about +2.2k tris. The near level adds +12k and the close level +37.5k. It is opaque (no alpha test, so the Apple GPU's hidden-surface removal still works). It uses 4 materials, the same foliage, petal and soil maps as the troughs: no new textures if Vela's troughs land first. The testbed's two island palms are separate, see 4.

2Atomic globe lamps in the fountain islands

fountain-garden-lights.js

A chrome and opal Saturn globe on a stepped post, with tilted orbit rings and satellite finials, one per island. Nothing is there today: the islands go dark at night (the 075 night shot), and the lamps would light the leaves and the paving round the fountain. By day they are a strong atom-age read at play size.

Owner: Vela (piece, from the script; opal = the existing DK_Pavilion_Opal) · Splice (4 placements from the island geometry, inner radius + 0.32 m) · Glint (night)

Cost: Computed: 4,064 tris for all four (1,016 each), in 2 draw batches. The testbed adds 4 point lights (range 5.8 m, no shadows) at night only. As emissive opal only, the cost is about 0. As real URP lights, it is a per-pixel light loop over about 2–4 % of a café frame: +0.03 to +0.1 ms at night, estimate.

3Records Office lit at night

civic-office-lighting.js

The testbed lights the office as an occupied building: a lobby downlight, a crown downlight, a canopy wash, banner downlights and two pier washes. In today's night shot the Records Office, the capstone's target, is a dark mass beside a lit café. The light belongs to the office glazing and canopy, not to new geometry.

Owner: Glint (light and emissive) · Vela (window/lobby emissive mask if the shell needs one)

Cost: 0 tris. The testbed uses 7 spot lights. The cheap Unity route is emissive lobby glass and canopy soffit plus at most 2 real spots: +0.05 to +0.2 ms in night views, estimate. Day: 0.

4Palms in raised planters round the square (the old CoconutPalm)

civic-planting-layout.js palms, fountain-garden-layout.js palms (layout intent); the palm itself stays the old one

Both the testbed and the 26 Sep paintings frame the square with palms in planters. Today the square itself has no palm: the zone's streets carry the old CoconutPalm along the kerbs (40 + 5 CoconutPalm_Street in the export inside the zone rectangle), but the six cafe-palm slots are PottedPalm_Small and the big paving between the pavilion and the fountain is empty. Use the old city's CoconutPalm (Sky's pick, decision log 2026-10-24), not the testbed palm.

Owner: Vantage (where, with sightlines to the door and the pickup) · Splice (generator) · Latch (rebuild) · Sky (approves a civic-block layout change)

Cost: CoconutPalm is 6,310 tris, and every palm stays at L0 at every play zoom (028 palm LOD board). Six palms is about +38k main tris (≈ +5 % of the café view's 769k) plus shadow casters. The testbed's two island palms are +12.6k. Measured counts are Latch's to take after a rebuild.

5The testbed planting system for the zone's other planters

flower-bed-layout.js, cafe-garden-composition.js, flower-look-shapes.js, garden-*-geometry.js

The office-front beds, the drop-off flanks and the terrace runs (PlanterRun ×12, OvalPlanter ×2, office beds) carry the same domes as the islands. The testbed's run builder and composition fill any run with mixed leaves and flower heads by seed, so it fits the civic block's planters. The testbed's own bed coordinates do not: civic-block.json is the layout.

Owner: Vela (after the troughs) · Redline (per-bed budget)

Cost: Heavy at testbed density. Computed: the testbed's 18 civic beds come to 214,780 tris at the gameplay level, about 11.9k per bed (380,664 near). The kit examples run 3,562 (corner) to 10,309 (sweep) per bed. Brief 076 said not to raise all foliage density. Needs a per-bed budget of about 3–4k (the island level) before rollout.

6Fountain water in motion

fountain-water.js

Ripples, caustics, jet flow and landing rings over the mosaic, in one opaque pass. Today DK_Fountain_Water is the static mosaic. Motion at the centre of the square is cheap life.

Owner: Glint

Cost: 0 tris. The pool is about 30 m², about 1–2 % of a café frame. About +40 ALU per pool pixel: < 0.02 ms, estimate. No refraction and no extra pass; skip the testbed's local cubemap probe (fountain-reflection.js).

7Headroom to pay for 1–4 (Sky's call: compression rule)

civic-fountain model-report.json levels; PlazaSphereLamp_Play

AtomFountain_Testbed is built from the testbed's close level (41,888 tris, no LOD) and draws it at every zoom. The testbed authored its own gameplay level (13,216) for this view. Separately, the 8 PlazaSphereLamp_Play in the zone are 7,932 tris each. Either change frees more than items 1, 2 and 4 add.

Owner: Sky (decides) · Vela (export the authored level) · Redline (confirm)

Cost: Fountain −28.7k tris in café views (from the testbed's model report; authored, not a decimation, but 028 left it to Sky). Lamps: up to −55k if a 372-tri StreetLampGlobe or a ≈1k globe post replaced them (a look change, so Sky).

8Pavilion downlights at night

pavilion-downlights.js

Four recessed downlights and the opal lens make the boarding pavilion read as a pickup point at night (028 bay board: testbed | now | proposed). BoardingPavilion_TB_Square is already in the zone.

Owner: Glint

Cost: 0 tris. 4 spots or emissive pools: +0.02 to +0.08 ms at night, estimate.

For Sky to decide

  1. What counts as "full detail" for the testbed planting at play zoom. Brief 077 carries brief 028's rule: no compression without Sky. But the testbed picks its own planting level by projected leaf size: 0.4 m leaves under 16 px take the gameplay level. At our play camera (zoom 14, 1920 px over about 49.8 m, about 38.6 px per metre) a leaf is about 15 px, so the testbed itself would draw the gameplay level here (computed from its LOD rule, cafe-garden-composition and fountain-garden). The gameplay level is authored, not decimated. The choice moves the cost two- to three-fold: islands 14,272 against 49,584; the café troughs 7,550 against 19,842. Recommendation: the gameplay level at play zoom, with near and close kept for close cameras.
  2. Palms in the square and the islands (item 4). This changes the civic block's layout (adjust ops), so it needs Sky's OK and Vantage's sightline check on the door and the pickup. Recommendation: yes, with the old CoconutPalm, about 6 of them.
  3. Headroom (item 7). Draw the fountain's authored gameplay level (−28.7k tris) and/or replace the 8 heavy plaza lamps. Both are compression or look calls under brief 028's rule. Recommendation: take the fountain's gameplay level at play zoom; keep the lamps as they are unless Sky wants the globe look anyway.
  4. Outside the zone. Should the testbed planting ever replace the old town's own planters? "Old is primary" says no for now. Recommendation: decide after items 1 and 5 have been seen.
  5. Records Office banners (civic-office-materials). The paintings show them and the swap has none. A look call on the civic block.

Not worth bringing

  • The testbed palm, including the 19,330-tri close level. Sky chose the old CoconutPalm (decision log 2026-10-24). The testbed palm reads as a tree fern. Every palm draws L0 at every play zoom (028 LOD board), so the close level would cost 3× the old palm with no gain at play size.
  • Civic forest. The old town continues the city where the testbed needed a green edge: 182 palms, 1,656 undergrowth clumps (≈ 305k tris) and an impostor atlas that is itself compression.
  • Impostor and card paths (flower-optimization-cards, chair-bake, forest-impostor-atlas): compression by the 028 rule.
  • The steward robot and the testbed sedan: Sky removed the steward, and cars067/070 carry the sedans. Mobility is covered by the old district life (RFM cars). People came through tools/figures. The fountain's local cubemap costs a pass for a small area.
